title: Map Dot Count Matches Page
description: The mocked-GPS map above the table only plots the shipments currently on screen, not the whole fleet — its own accessible label needs to say exactly that number, and the rendered dots need to match it precisely.
successCondition: With more shipments in the system than fit on one page, the TrackingMap's <svg role="img"> aria-label reads "Map showing the live position of N shipment(s)" where N exactly equals the number of shipment rows currently rendered in the table below it (not the grand total), and the count of rendered position <circle> elements inside the map (excluding the smaller origin/destination dot markers) equals that same N — re-verified after changing pages, where both N and the dot count should update together.
hints: Each shipment renders three circles (origin, destination, current position) — distinguish the moving "current position" dot (radius 3, pulsing) from the two static endpoint markers (radius 2) when counting.
Changing the page changes which shipments prop is passed to TrackingMap — the map has no independent data source of its own.
